field_principles.blocked_devices: names devices with unavailable identity, runtime, or safe command receipts.
field_principles.cpu_receipt: authenticated local CPU command receipt with device and runtime metadata.
field_principles.cuda_receipt: authenticated local CUDA command receipt with GPU, driver, and runtime metadata when reachable.
field_principles.forbidden_kv260_host_sdcard_used: must be false to preserve the retired KV260 SD-card boundary.
field_principles.gatemate_receipt: safe host/toolchain identity only; no flashing or workload overclaim.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claim: must remain false without authenticated matched timing.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claim_allowed: promotion gate derived from matched timing and safe receipts.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal status with no speedup overclaim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: declares hardware_receipts, not live inference or benchmark acceleration.
field_principles.kv260_receipt: KV260 evidence limited to SSH, xmutil, and remote UIO paths; never host SD-card storage.
field_principles.matched_timing_available: true only when equivalent CPU, GPU, and FPGA timings exist.
field_principles.polar_fire_receipt: SSH-only PolarFire reachability plus board-side identity or hash data when available.
field_principles.receipt_commands: bounded command transcripts with exit codes, hashes, durations, and blocked reasons.
field_principles.timing_methodology: records workload, warmup, repetitions, clock source, host/device split, and matched timing availability.
